designs.title: Fanad Head Lighthouse
designs.why: Solid poster structure, correct facts, clean small type. But the cliff mass is nearly solid black, so it turns into a blown-out white slab on the black main tee. And because the film is a straight negative, the white tower prints as an empty black silhouette. The arched heading also sags to the left, and its letter edges have small tracing burrs.
designs.fix: Re-separate the art for the black tee: open up the cliff hatching to about 50-60% ink, and give the tower its own white fill and line work instead of a plain inversion.

designs.title: Portland Head Light
designs.why: The best-balanced scene of the set: house, tower and ledges sit well inside the frame. The rock hatching is open enough to hold up in white ink, and the facts and coordinates are accurate and legible. Minor issues: the heading arch is lopsided (the D sits lower than the P), the edge burrs show at full size, and FIRST LIT has a double space.
designs.fix: Rebuild the heading as a clean, symmetric vector arch: true outlines without burrs, plus fix the FIRST  LIT spacing.

designs.title: Cape Agulhas Lighthouse
designs.why: The cleanest engraving: the banded tower, keeper's house and pylons are drawn crisply with good open hatching, and the heading arch is the most even of the four. The facts and coordinates are correct. But there are only two short lines of facts on each side and no subtitle under the heading, so the upper third feels empty and less finished than its siblings.
designs.fix: Add a LIGHTHOUSE subtitle rule under the heading, plus a third fact on each side (e.g. southernmost tip of Africa / tower 27 m), to match the series' density.

designs.title: Phare de Saint-Mathieu
designs.why: The strongest composition: the abbey ruins beside the tower tell a story the others lack. The two-tier heading with its Plougonvelin line reads well from 3 m, and the facts (1835, 37 m) are right. The line weight is even and printable. The only weaknesses: in the negative the white tower again reads as dark on the black tee, and there are a few tiny specks in the rock texture that will fill in or drop out.
designs.fix: Despeckle the rock and grass texture to a minimum line or dot of about 0.3 mm at print size, and give the tower a white fill in the black-tee separation.
